title: The Area Connection
teaches: Understanding that the sum of the areas of the two smaller squares equals the area of the largest square.
visual: The blue and green squares (on sides a and b) become semi-transparent. Their contents flow like liquid into the red square (on side c), perfectly filling it without spilling over. Numbers appear: if a=3 and b=4, the areas 9 and 16 merge to fill the area 25 of the red square.
narration: Here is the magic: if you add the area of the blue square and the green square together, it exactly equals the area of the big red square. This means the combined space of the two smaller squares matches the largest one perfectly.

title: The Formula Revealed
teaches: Stating the algebraic formula a² + b² = c².
visual: The geometric shapes fade slightly into the background. Large, bold text appears in the foreground: 'a² + b² = c²'. The variables 'a', 'b', and 'c' pulse briefly to connect them back to the triangle sides shown earlier. The equation remains on screen for emphasis.
narration: This relationship is called the Pythagoras Theorem. It states that the square of the hypotenuse is equal to the sum of the squares of the other two sides. So, simply put: a squared plus b squared equals c squared.
